description: This PHP file provides a web interface for resetting and restoring a network gateway. It includes server-side PHP includes for headers, footers, and navigation, as well as client-side JavaScript for handling user interactions such as resetting the device, reset Wi-Fi modules, restore settings, and reset password. The file also manages user permissions, device states, and triggers server-side actions via AJAX.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Triggers an AJAX request to reset or restore the device, showing progress and handling reboot or Wi-Fi restart based on server response.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Checks if the device has rebooted by polling the index page; redirects to login after reboot.

methods.name: setBatteryInfo
methods.description: Sends an AJAX request to re-establish battery connection.
